title: MiniMax H3 Image with references
description: Local MiniMax H3-Image (33B, 6 steps, no CFG) from the pruned Q4_K_M GGUF, guided by up to four pictures. Write @Image 1 to @Image 4 in the prompt; they reach the model as <Picture 1> to <Picture 4>, renumbered when a slot is empty. Picture 1 is the main reference or the picture to change. Output keeps Picture 1's proportions by default; choose a format to set them yourself. Size choice is 4, 6, 8, 12 or 20 MP; 12 and 20 MP reference edits are verified through the app.

evidence: Same graph as minimax-h3-image-t2i plus the official multi-image pattern from Comfy-Org image_minimax_h3_image_edit.json: each picture is a LoadImage connected to MiniMaxH3ImageConditioning images.image_N. The node sorts the slots by number and labels them <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, ... in packed order (ComfyUI 0.45.1 comfy_extras/nodes_minimax_h3.py _image_refs). The official edit template pre-scales the source to 4 MP; here the node's own reference scaling is used and the canvas comes from the format control.

2026-11-12: Size choice is 4, 6, 8, 12 or 20 MP. ComfyUI's core ResolutionSelector refuses megapixels above 16, so src/capabilities/h3-image-mentions.ts computes the 32 px canvas from the format and writes width/height straight into MiniMaxH3ImageConditioning for 20 MP; the 4-12 MP path stays on the selector unchanged. App runs through :8787 on the H3 worker: 12 MP 3552x3552 in 341.5 s (run 539d56b4, asset b843c4ab), 20 MP 4576x4576 in 357.7 s (run 527b4e92, asset 0766d9fe), both with two pictures: the fisherman source plus the portrait reference, which appears next to him in the 20 MP result.
